# TrustyTooltip

`Overlays` · composition depth: `base`

A short text hint that appears on hover or focus, anchored to an edge of its trigger. Plain string only, so every tooltip stays on the design system.

**Use it when**
- a control needs a few words of clarification, icon-only buttons especially.

**Don't use it for**
- anything the user must read to proceed: a tooltip is invisible until discovered. Put essential text in the layout, or in TrustyFormItem's hint for form fields.

```ts
import { TrustyTooltip } from '@louislp/trusty-ui'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | *required* | Tooltip text. Plain string only: keeps every tooltip on the design system |
| `side` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | `"top"` | Which edge of the trigger the tooltip is anchored to |
| `alignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | `"center"` | How the tooltip is aligned relative to the trigger |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the tooltip entirely (trigger still renders) |

## Slots

- `default`

## Examples in Storybook

- Default — Default: text on hover/focus, anchored above the trigger.
- Right — Anchor to any edge of the trigger.
- Bottom
- StartAligned — Align the tooltip to the start, center, or end of the trigger.
- EndAligned
- BottomStartAligned — Different anchored side AND alignment.
- Disabled — Disabled — the trigger renders but the tooltip never opens.
